source.title: Micronutrients and Diabetic Retinopathy: Evidence From The National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey and a Meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Lower levels of circulating vitamins C, D, and E were found in DR patients than those without. More high-quality studies are required to assess the real effects of micronutrients on DR.

cards.headline: Glycative stress as a cause of macular degeneration

source.title: Glycative stress as a cause of macular degeneration.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: Here we summarized the current knowledge regarding the pathological role of glycative stress in retinal dysfunction and how dietary strategies might diminish retinal disease.

cards.headline: Thermal Pulsation in the Management of Meibomian Gland Dysfunction and Dry Eye

source.title: Thermal Pulsation in the Management of Meibomian Gland Dysfunction and Dry Eye: A Report by the American Academy of Ophthalmology.
source.excerpt: According to the current literature, a single thermal pulsation session may improve subjective or objective parameters of MGD and dry eye safely. However, industry support and participation were present in 4 of the 8 level I studies. The durability beyond several months and cost efficacy remain uncertain.

cards.headline: AI image generation technology in ophthalmology: Use, misuse and future applications

source.title: AI image generation technology in ophthalmology: Use, misuse and future applications.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: Compared to other medical applications of AI, image generation is still in its infancy. Yet, it holds the potential to revolutionise ophthalmology across research, education and clinical practice.

cards.headline: Deep learning-based differentiation of FLASH ultrasound windows

source.title: Deep learning-based differentiation of FLASH ultrasound windows.
source.excerpt: The developed deep learning tool demonstrates the feasibility of automated recognition of standardized equine FLASH windows and may support ultrasound training as an educational aid for first-day competencies. Future incorporation of organ-level annotations and probe position information may improve discrimination between anatomically similar windows and enhance model performance.

source.title: Artificial intelligence in modern medicine: a comprehensive review of technologies, applications, and future directions.
source.excerpt: To transition from retrospective experimental success to standard-of-care clinical integration, future research endeavors must prioritize Explainable AI (XAI), federated learning frameworks for privacy preservation, and rigorous prospective clinical validation under standardized regulatory oversight.

source.title: Ballon d’Or
source.excerpt: Der Ballon d’Or ist ein seit 1956 von der französischen Fußball-Fachzeitschrift France Football vergebener Preis an die besten Fußballspieler des jeweiligen Kalenderjahres bzw. seit 2022 der vorherigen Saison. Ursprünglich nur für europäische Spieler von europäischen Vereinen vorgesehen, öffnete sich der Preis ab 1995 für alle Spieler, die in Europa spielten.

source.title: Large Internal Limiting Membrane Tears: Prevalence, Clinical Characteristics, and Surgical Utility.
source.excerpt: Large ILM tears are often present in eyes undergoing surgery for ERM and are likely caused by ERM contracture. Careful preoperative identification of these tears is helpful for surgical planning because the scrolled flap of ILM provides a convenient and safe "handle" for initiating membrane peeling.

cards.headline: A Review of the Prevalence of Ophthalmologic Diseases in Native American Populations

source.title: A Review of the Prevalence of Ophthalmologic Diseases in Native American Populations.
source.excerpt: There are considerable inequities in the prevalence and treatment rates of ophthalmologic conditions in AI/AN individuals. A likely explanation is the barrier of lack of access to adequate health and eye care. Because of substantial underinsurance and geographic variability, attention needs to be brought to expanding eye care access to AI/AN communities.

source.title: Eye on the horizon: The metabolic landscape of the RPE in aging and disease.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: Lastly, we discuss promising avenues for future research investigating the roles of these pathological conditions on retinal metabolism, potentially offering novel therapeutic approaches to combat age-related retinal disease.

source.title: Oculomics: Current concepts and evidence.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: Furthermore, oculomics with AI allows prediction of the risk of systemic diseases, enabling risk stratification, opening up new avenues for prevention or individualized risk prediction and prevention, facilitating personalized medicine.

source.title: Artificial intelligence in hepatitis: Advances in diagnosis, treatment optimization, and prognostic prediction.
source.publisher: The Journal of international medical research
source.excerpt: Future progress will depend on prospective multicenter evaluation, use of interoperable multimodal data, development of transparent models that account for uncertainty, and evidence that artificial intelligence improves clinical decisions and patient outcomes rather than performance metrics alone.

cards.headline: The association between prediabetes and obstructive sleep apnea syndrome: a meta-analysis

source.title: The association between prediabetes and obstructive sleep apnea syndrome: a meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Prediabetes is significantly associated with a higher prevalence of OSAS in adults. These findings highlight the frequent coexistence of early glucose dysregulation and sleep-disordered breathing and support consideration of OSAS screening in individuals with prediabetes.

source.title: Florence Kasumba
source.excerpt: Florence Kasumba ist eine deutsche Schauspielerin, Musicaldarstellerin und Synchronsprecherin. Im deutschen Fernsehen absolvierte sie zahlreiche Gastrollen, bis sie 2018 durchgängig in der Serie Deutschland 86 zu sehen war und von 2019 bis 2024 als Tatort-Kommissarin Anaïs Schmitz des NDR an der Seite von Maria Furtwängler agierte.

cards.headline: Und diejenigen, die nicht Bescheid wissen …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:118
source.excerpt: وقال الجهلة من أهل الكتاب وغيرهم لنبي الله ورسوله محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم على سبيل العناد: هلا يكلمنا الله مباشرة ليخبرنا أنك رسوله، أو تأتينا معجزة من الله تدل على صدقك. ومثل هذا القول قالته الأمم من قبلُ لرسلها عنادًا ومكابرة; بسبب تشابه قلوب السابقين واللاحقين في الكفر والضَّلال، قد أوضحنا الآيات للذين يصدِّقون تصديقًا جازمًا؛ لكونهم مؤمنين بالله تعالى، متَّبعين ما شرعه لهم.

cards.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ لَوْلَا يُكَلِّمُنَا ٱللَّهُ أَوْ تَأْتِينَآ ءَايَةٌ ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّثْلَ قَوْلِهِمْ ۘ تَشَـٰبَهَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
cards.translation: Und diejenigen, die nicht Bescheid wissen, sagen: „O würde Allah doch zu uns sprechen oder käme zu uns ein Zeichen! Dergleichen Worte führten schon diejenigen, die vor ihnen waren. Ihre Herzen sind einander ähnlich. Wir haben die Zeichen klargemacht für Leute, die überzeugt sind.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Muhammad bin Ishaq reported that Ibn `Abbas said that Rafi` bin Huraymilah said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "O Muhammad! If you were truly a Messenger from Allah, as you claim, then ask Allah to speak to us directly, so that we hear His Speech."

cards.headline: Gewiß, Wir haben dich mit der Wahrheit gesandt als Frohboten und als Warner.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:119
source.excerpt: إنَّا أرسلناك -أيها الرسولُ- بالدِّيْنِ الحق المؤيد بالحجج والمعجزات، فبلِّغه للناس مع تبشير المؤمنين بخيري الدنيا والآخرة، وتخويف المعاندين بما ينتظرهم من عذاب الله، ولست -بعد البلاغ- مسئولا عن كفر مَن كفر بك; فإنهم يدخلون النار يوم القيامة، ولا يخرجون منها.

cards.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تُسْـَٔلُ عَنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
cards.translation: Gewiß, Wir haben dich mit der Wahrheit gesandt als Frohboten und als Warner. Und du wirst nicht nach den (Taten der) Insassen des Höllenbrandes gefragt werden.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Allah's statement; وَلاَ تُسْـَلُ عَنْ أَصْحَـبِ الْجَحِيمِ (And you will not be asked about the dwellers of the blazing Fire.) means, "We shall not ask you about the disbelief of those who rejected you."
